newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan BSPA buys 162,000T US soybeans at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan BSPA buys 162,000T US soybeans at tender.

text.p: The Kaohsiung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought three 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. soybeans at a tender on Wednesday, traders said.
The breakfast association's Kaohsiung division comprises Great Wall Enterprise, President Enterprise, President subsidiary Ttet Union and unlisted Tai Hwa Oil.
Traders said Agrex will provide the first shipment, Bunge the second and Zennoh the third.
Traders said the tender was prompted mainly by a belief among buyers that freight prices are at a low. All three shipments were bought on cost-and-freight basis.
